description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 4.3. Bulk-insert like bench_sync (O(n log n), never replay turns). Shapes star/wide/random/chain; record the realized depth histogram (min/median/max hops to root). Author messages as today. Realism: real graphs are shallow-and-wide, so measure all shapes and do not report only the deep number.

title: bench_order on chained seed: measure tax by depth
description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 4.4. Verify the deleg reconstruction recovers the multi-hop tree via JOINS, not the ephemeral invitee field (sec 7 trap). Measure ts/author/deleg. Hypothesis: deleg tax ~ 4 x depth(subtree), path-length-bounded not N-bounded; deleg beats author/ts on the deep shape and reproduces A.5 on the star. Add a depth column.

title: Green guard: bench_sync + check_leaves on chained seed
description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 7.3. bench_sync catchup/bidi and check_leaves (leaves-are-piles) must still pass on the chained seed: every published leaf carries its full delegation closure. Use it as an oracle.

description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 1 / 4.1. Change the one needs() line admin to member; docstring states any member or the founder may invite. Unit test: a member-signed invite validates, a non-member-signed one is rejected. This one line is the whole depth mechanism, and per WORKSPACES.md the same primitive powers cross-device mirroring and infra.

description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 3.7. Port the poc-13 admin grant (member-gated by the founder root) if evict authority should delegate beyond the founder. Independent of the measurement; skip if not needed.

title: device/device_invite + direct-key grant form
description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 6. user-vs-device split. Gate behind seed flag devices_per_user (default 1 = Phase 1 behavior).
